en.headline: More than 34,000 subdivided units registered as early-bird window closes
en.dek: The first six-month fee-waiver phase under the Basic Housing Units Ordinance ended on Monday; a second registration window runs until 28 February 2027.
body: More than 34,000 subdivided units had been registered under Hong Kong's Basic Housing Units regime by the time the first six-month early-bird window closed on Monday, according to figures cited by the Housing Bureau and reported on Tuesday.

The ordinance, which took effect on 1 March, requires pre-existing subdivided flats used for letting to be registered during a 12-month period ending 28 February 2027 if owners want a 36-month grace period before full enforcement. Landlords who applied by 31 August were eligible for a full waiver of the HK$3,000 annual certification fee for each unit for the first three years. Applications filed from 1 September to 28 February 2027 receive a full waiver for the first two years and a half waiver in the third year.

The government has estimated that about 80,000 units could eventually be accredited, while the Housing Bureau has separately put the number of subdivided-flat households citywide at about 110,000. Legislative Council housing panel deputy chairman Scott Leung Man-kwong told a radio programme the mid-30,000 figure was acceptable and that more owners were likely to register closer to the enforcement period. He said ownership checks on inherited flats had delayed some filings.

Local reports said only a small number of units, about 29, had so far been certified as basic housing units meeting standards such as a minimum internal floor area of eight square metres, an independent toilet and a window. Registration itself remains open until next February, and the Housing Bureau has urged remaining owners and operators to apply.

zh.headline: 簡樸房早鳥登記截止 逾3.4萬個分間單位已登記
zh.dek: 首輪全額寬免認證費優惠已於周一結束；第二輪登記即日至2027年2月28日，寬免幅度較首輪減少。
body: 房屋局公布的數字顯示，截至「簡樸房」制度首輪早鳥登記周一結束，全港已有超過3.4萬個分間單位完成登記。有報道指部分業主趕及在限期前到專責小組辦事處交表。
《簡樸房條例》今年3月1日生效，既存作出租用途的分間單位須於2027年2月28日前完成12個月登記期申請，方可取得其後36個月寬限期。8月31日或之前交表的業主，首三年每年3,000元認證申請費可獲全額寬免；9月1日至明年2月28日才交表，則首兩年全免、第三年半免。
政府估計最終約8萬個單位可獲認證，房屋局亦指全港約11萬戶劍房。立法會房屋事務委員會副主席梁文廣在電台節目形容目前數字中規中矙，相信越近執法期會有更多人登記，並指部分承繼物業因業權核實而延誤申請。
有本地報道指至今只有約29個單位完成簡樸房認證，須符合不少於8平方米內部樓面面積、獨立廁所及窗戶等最低標準。登記期仍開放至明年2月，房屋局呼籲尚未辦理的業主及營運者盡快申請。
